name: Veyra Spellthief
lore: An exile of Ebonwake who stole the Citadel’s forbidden ledger and learned to turn cruel magic against its masters.

primary.name: Echo Brand
primary.description: Fire a brand: 40% of its damage on contact, the rest after 1.2 seconds. Enemy movement before the echo adds up to 14 damage. Repeated hits strengthen an existing brand without restarting its timer.

secondary.name: Spell Snare
secondary.description: Place a snare at your aim. For 2.5 seconds it catches up to six moving enemy shots, then returns them as 14-damage friendly bolts toward nearby foes. It cannot stop floor attacks or lobbed explosions.

special.name: Soul Ledger
special.description: Bind up to four nearby enemies for 5 seconds, dealing 10 damage each. Damage dealt to one spreads 25% to the other linked enemies, capped at 12 per shared hit. Shared damage never triggers another share.

passive: Quick Study: returned Spell Snare bolts slow their target for one second.

technique.name: Patient Snare
technique.description: Spell Snare stays open 50% longer, but recharges 40% slower.

final_technique.name: Borrowed Constellation
final_technique.description: Strike up to four enemies in a delayed linked constellation for 25 each and a brief slow. Trades the stored-spell ledger for reliable multi-target control.

attack.name: Borrowed Constellation
attack.description: Strike up to four enemies in a delayed linked constellation for 25 each and a brief slow. Trades the stored-spell ledger for reliable multi-target control.
